title: Children with Christmas Gifts by Tree, 1957 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group of children and youths gather in a mid-century living room next to a decorated Christmas tree and a vintage television set, proudly displaying their holiday presents. One boy holds a tennis racket, a young girl in a patterned puff-sleeve dress holds a wrapped gift box, and the younger boys wear classic 1950s suspenders and plaid button-downs. Stamped 'JAN • 57' along the top margin, capturing postwar American family holiday traditions.
